authority: Official Supercell Clash of Clans release notes

sources.title: The Town Hall 17 Update Is Here
Welcome to Let's Get Crafty Update
The Sound of Clash Update Is Here
The Anime Fury Update Is Here

facts: Troops, Spells, and Siege Machines no longer use training time.
Heroes no longer require healing time.
Army Recipes replaced the former training workflow.
The Cookbook became a third Army Recipes tab.
Crafted Defenses became a temporary Town Hall 17 defense system.
Only one Crafted Defense can be active at a time.
Regular Battles are available from Town Hall 2, endless, and do not risk Trophies.
Ranked Battles are available from Town Hall 7, use weekly tournaments, and have limited attacks.
Revenge returned as a 12-hour regular-battle Shadow Base route.
Town Hall 18 became the maximum Town Hall level.
Guardians became a separate Town Hall defense system.
One Guardian can be active at a time and Guardian upgrades do not require a Builder.
Dragon Duke became the sixth Home Village Hero.
Dragon Duke is available from Town Hall 15 and begins at level 1.
Hero Hall, Blacksmith, and Profile screens were changed to display six Heroes.
Legend League is divided into Legend III, Legend II, and Legend I.
Legend III provides 24 attacks per week and Legend II provides 30 attacks per week.
Legend I uses a four-week tournament and eight attacks per League Day.
An additional Builder is available in Builder Base from Builder Hall 2 after all Home Village Builders are unlocked.
Barbarian King now unlocks at Town Hall 4.
Hero Journey is available in Hero Hall from Town Hall 7.
Global Chat returned with Groups, Communities, and Town Square surfaces.
A 4x Fast Forward control can appear after 120 seconds in supported live battles.
Dragon Duke trap damage reduction was reduced again.
The Logger Guardian rolling range was reduced by two tiles.
Rocket Backpack and Flame Blower behavior was temporarily reverted pending a full update.
